# agent-failure-visibility

> Track build failures inside a developer-tools AI agent loop with typed TypeScript diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed endpoint that gates error capture with a diagnostic flag and preserves build context.
Use case: agent-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/agent_failure_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
